title: BendVLM: Test-Time Debiasing of Vision-Language Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring KL Divergence, MaxSkew, and Worst Group AUC ROC for image retrieval and zero-shot classification using neutral (e.g., hair color) and stereotype queries across gender annotations in face datasets (CelebA, FairFace, UTKFace).

Measuring KL Divergence and MaxSkew for image retrieval using stereotype queries across race annotations in face datasets (FairFace, UTKFace), and computing average negative sentiment scores of generated image captions across different racial groups.
